_doc: Which stick and throttle controls each activity view shows, chosen by hand; build_reference.py fills in the wording from the card tables in tools/regen_cards.py (lists AB6, MHG_L, MHG_R on js1; MTQ_L, MTQ_R on js2), so the strip cannot drift from the printed cards. A control is named `<device> <card label>`, as the card prints it. `where` is the physical control, in words from CLAUDE.md section 3. `variant` picks which card wording applies (mining -> 'Mine:', salvage -> 'Salv:', missile -> 'Msl:'); without it the mode's own variant is used, else the primary function. `status` is what CLAUDE.md says about the binding: flown (confirmed in a ship), unverified (bound and loaded, not yet confirmed in a ship), trial (the docs call it a trial). No status means the docs raise no doubt. tests/test_reference.py fails when a label here no longer exists on the cards.
